Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("IRF2_Project_FigureS1.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)

# Define list of immune cell type
cell_types <- c("B.cells.naive","B.cells.memory","Plasma.cells",
                "T.cells.CD8","T.cells.CD4.naive","T.cells.CD4.memory.resting","T.cells.CD4.memory.activated",
                "T.cells.follicular.helper","T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.","T.cells.gamma.delta",
                "NK.cells.resting","NK.cells.activated",
                "Monocytes","Macrophages.M0","Macrophages.M1","Macrophages.M2",
                "Dendritic.cells.resting","Dendritic.cells.activated",
                "Mast.cells.resting","Mast.cells.activated",
                "Eosinophils","Neutrophils"
                )
```


Combine TCGA lung cancer groups LUAD and LUSC into NSCLC.
```{r}
# Transpose TCGA gene expression matrix
# Gene from rows to columns
# Sample from columns to rows
df_tcga <- combined_expr_matrix_tpm_lung_skcm %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "Symbol") %>%
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "SampleID")

# Add StudyID columns
StudyID <- combined_meta_lung_skcm$title[match(df_tcga$SampleID, combined_meta_lung_skcm$barcode)]

df_tcga <- tibble::add_column(df_tcga, .after = 1, StudyID)

df_tcga <- df_tcga %>%
  mutate(StudyID = ifelse(StudyID %in% c("LUAD","LUSC"), "NSCLC",StudyID))

# Draw gene-gene scatter plot
FigS6_TCGA_IRF2_IFNG <- plot_gene_gene_scatter(df = df_tcga,
                                             geneA = "IFNG",
                                             geneB = "IRF2",
                                             cohort_col = "StudyID",
                                             cohorts = c("NSCLC","SKCM"),
                                             norm_type = "log2",
                                             free_scales = FALSE) 

FigS6_TCGA_IRF2_IFNG
```

```{r}
# Draw gene-gene scatter plot
FigS6_TCGA_CXCL9_IFNG <- plot_gene_gene_scatter(df = df_tcga,
                                             geneA = "IFNG",
                                             geneB = "CXCL9",
                                             cohort_col = "StudyID",
                                             cohorts = c("NSCLC","SKCM"),
                                             norm_type = "log2",
                                             free_scales = FALSE) 

FigS6_TCGA_CXCL9_IFNG
```


```{r}
FigS6_comb <- ggarrange(FigS6_TCGA_IRF2_IFNG,
                   FigS6_TCGA_CXCL9_IFNG,
                   nrow = 2, ncol = 1, align = "hv")

FigS6_comb
```

Export Figure.
```{r}
setwd("/Users/patipark/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/UMass_Chan/IRF2_Project/IRF2_Manuscript_Figures_v6")

pdf("FigureS6_comb.pdf", 
    width = 8, 
    height = 7,
    paper = "a4r")

FigS6_comb

dev.off()
```

Separate TCGA lung cancer groups - LUAD and LUSC
```{r}
# Transpose TCGA gene expression matrix
# Gene from rows to columns
# Sample from columns to rows
df_tcga_indv <- df_tcga %>%
  dplyr::select(-StudyID)

# Add StudyID columns
StudyID <- combined_meta_lung_skcm$title[match(df_tcga_indv$SampleID, combined_meta_lung_skcm$barcode)]

df_tcga_indv <- tibble::add_column(df_tcga_indv, .after = 1, StudyID)


# Draw gene-gene scatter plot
FigS6_INDV_IRF2_IFNG <- plot_gene_gene_scatter(df = df_tcga_indv,
                                             geneA = "IFNG",

                                             cohort_col = "StudyID",
                                             cohorts = c("LUAD","LUSC","SKCM"),
                                             norm_type = "log2",
                                             free_scales = FALSE)

```
